entries.name: Axes
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Combat with axe-type weapons: hand axes, battle axes, greataxes, and dual axes. Governs power strikes and cleave technique.

entries.name: Bludgeons
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Combat with blunt weapons: maces, hammers, clubs, flails, and morning stars. Governs crushing force and concussive strikes.

entries.name: Bows
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Use of bow weapons: shortbows, hunting bows, recurve bows, composite bows, compound bows, longbows, and war bows. Governs draw, aim, release, range judgement, and rhythm at range.

entries.name: Brawling
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Unarmed combat: punches, kicks, headbutts, and improvised strikes. Includes knuckle weapons and similar.

entries.name: Crossbows
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Use of crossbows: hand crossbow, light crossbow, hunting crossbow, standard crossbow, repeating crossbow, heavy crossbow, and arbalest. Governs aim, timing, bracing, reload discipline, specialized bolts, and prepared shots at range.

entries.name: Dueling
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Combat with weapons assigned to the Dueling weapon family, emphasizing precision, measure, point control, feints, parries, and ripostes. It applies whenever a Dueling-family weapon is used in combat, not only in formal or one-on-one duels. Use the weapon's established family rather than treating it as Light Blades simply because it is light or one-handed.

entries.name: Heavy Blades
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Combat with large cutting blades: longswords, bastard swords, claymores, greatswords, odachi, tachi, sword whips, and similar heavy one- or two-handed blades. Governs reach, leverage, edge alignment, and decisive cuts.

entries.name: Lances
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Combat with lances and lance-style weapons, primarily from horseback. Governs mounted charges and couched lance technique.

entries.name: Light Blades
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
One-handed light cutting and thrusting weapons: daggers, dirks, stilettos, hunting knives, short swords, kodachi, and paired daggers. Governs fast close attacks, precision, and off-hand blade work.

entries.name: Polearms
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Combat with pole-mounted blade weapons: halberds, glaives, fauchards, bardiches, partisans, billhooks, scythes, and similar reach weapons. Governs reach control, hooks, sweeps, and keeping enemies at distance.

entries.name: Shields
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Active shield use in combat: blocking, bashing, positioning, and cover. Distinct from simply carrying a shield.

entries.name: Slings
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Use of slings and similar projectile devices for stone or shot. Uncommonly skilled but inexpensive and effective.

entries.name: Spears
entries.summary:
Attribute: Fighting
Combat with thrusting spear weapons: short spears, long spears, boar spears, winged spears, pikes, tridents, and similar point-forward pole weapons. Governs formation reach, bracing, thrusts, and point control.

entries.name: Staff Fighting
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Combat use of staff weapons: quarterstaffs, bo staves, battle staves, mage staves used as weapons, and similar two-handed shaft weapons. Governs control, sweeps, blocks, leverage, and striking rhythm. Do not use this skill for casting spells through a staff.

entries.name: Thrown Weapons
entries.summary:
Attribute: Accuracy
Use of thrown weapons and effect-delivery projectiles: throwing knives, axes, javelins, darts, chakrams, shuriken, kunai, alchemical flasks, and similar ranged hand-thrown weapons. Governs aim, timing, spin, range judgement, quick draw, and target selection.

entries.name: Abyss Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of bottomless depth, crushing pressure, devouring darkness, deep silence, descent, isolation, and the terror of an immeasurable below. Abyss Arcana manifests those qualities together as abyssal force: dragging, smothering, suppressing, separating, and overwhelming through supernatural depth. It does not grant unrestricted Shadow, Gravity, Air, or other Arcana simply because abyssal manifestations can resemble darkness, pull, pressure, or suffocation.

entries.name: Acid Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Manipulates acid, corrosion, caustic liquid, etching, dissolving reactions, and controlled material breakdown. Governs chemical burns, weakening armor, dissolving locks, damaging organic or mineral matter, and dangerous alchemical reactions. Distinct from Poison Arcana, which works through toxins inside living bodies.

entries.name: Aegis Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of supreme protection, guardian force, interposition, last stands, refusal of catastrophic harm, and the boundary between disaster and survival. Aegis Arcana excels at sheltering, holding, intercepting, anchoring, and preserving under extreme threat. Its protection is legendary but not effortless invulnerability: strength of effect still depends on the action, success, opposition, and circumstances.

entries.name: Air Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Manipulates air, wind, breath, pressure, and atmospheric movement. Governs windblasts, suffocation risk, air cushioning, flight assistance, redirected projectiles, and pressure shifts.

entries.name: Beast Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Magically interacts with animals, beast instincts, animal communication, command, bonding, and partial beast-like transformation. Use Beast Arcana only for magical animal interaction, magical beast speech, supernatural bonding, magical command, or transformation; ordinary animal care and control uses Animal Handling.

entries.name: Blood Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Rarity: Rare
Magic of blood, vitality, injury, lineage signs, sacrifice, life-force tension, and the dangerous boundary between healing and harm. Blood Arcana is potent, intimate, physically costly, and widely restricted.

entries.name: Bone Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates bone and fossil material, skeletal constructs, structural alignment, protective reinforcement, and non-invasive recognition of fractures or strain. Distinct from Death Arcana because it works through physical structure and preserved material rather than death-state energy. It does not forcibly reshape or control the skeleton of a living creature.

entries.name: Cold Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Manipulates cold, ice, freezing, temperature reduction, frost formation, slowing effects, preservation, and crystalline barriers. Often called ice magic by commoners, but formally known as Cold Arcana.

entries.name: Conjuration Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Summons, calls, binds, or manifests entities, servants, familiars, temporary constructs, and other defined presences through magical conduits. Conjuration governs bringing and maintaining the summoned presence rather than granting unrestricted control over whatever substance or power that presence embodies. A summoned creature or construct may have its own capabilities, but Conjuration Arcana does not by itself reproduce another Arcana's independent domain control.

entries.name: Crystal Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates crystal, gems, facets, hard growth, refracted light, resonance, stored energy, and brittle structures that hold force until they fracture. Crystals can serve as lenses, anchors, or magical reservoirs.

entries.name: Death Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Interacts with death-state energy, dying thresholds, the recently dead, life-force drain, corpse animation, and the boundary between living and dead. It governs necromantic effects rooted in death itself. Use Soul Arcana for direct manipulation of living essence or identity, Spirit Arcana for independent spirits and hauntings, Healing Arcana for restoring ordinary bodily harm, and Bone Arcana for physical bone shaping.

entries.name: Divination Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Reads hidden information through magical detection, omen-reading, scrying, trace interpretation, distant perception, and signs beyond normal senses. Use Divination Arcana only when the character actively uses magic to reveal hidden information, detect traces, read omens, scry, or perceive beyond normal senses; mundane room searches use Searching or Seeing.

entries.name: Dragon Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Legendary
Ancient draconic magic expressed through a stable Draconic Type and Nature. Dragon Arcana governs distinctly draconic manifestations such as breath, scales, claws and fangs, bodily reinforcement, resistance, movement, senses, partial transformation, and draconic presence. Its Nature determines the tangible substance or directly observable natural phenomenon those manifestations express, but does not grant unrestricted control over that substance or phenomenon as an independent magical domain. On lower successes, manifestations are limited, brief, or narrowly effective; stronger successes increase force, scale, endurance, precision, or completeness of the draconic expression while remaining within the established Type and Nature.

entries.name: Dream Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Interacts with dreams, symbols, sleep-thresholds, omens, shared visions, half-remembered places, and the structure of magical dream-spaces. Its controlled effects are limited to dream-space imagery, communication, protection, and structure.

entries.name: Earth Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Manipulates earth, stone, soil, ground pressure, barriers, tremors, and underground structure. Governs stone shaping, earthworks, seismic effects, stability, and terrain control. Earth Arcana does not grant general control over worked metal or crystal and gems simply because they originated in the ground; use Metal Arcana or Crystal Arcana for those established domains.

entries.name: Echo Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Rarity: Rare
Reads and shapes lingering impressions left by events, emotions, voices, spells, wounds, deaths, or powerful presences. Echoes reveal what remains after something happened, but they are partial, symbolic, distorted, or emotionally charged rather than perfect records.

entries.name: Enchantment Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Places persistent magical effects on objects, locations, thresholds, and willing bearers. Governs imbuing enduring magical properties, conditions, permissions, reactive effects, and item enchantments designed to continue after the initial casting. Enchantment Arcana governs persistence and imbuement; Rune Arcana governs magic expressed through physical inscriptions, while Seal Arcana governs containment, suppression, closure, and ward-locking.

entries.name: Fate Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of destiny, omen, blessing, curse, fortunate timing, unlucky collapse, and paths that seem ready to happen. Fate Arcana does not guarantee outcomes; it reveals turning points, bends likelihood, and makes choices feel weighted by consequence.

entries.name: Fiber Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Magically manipulates nonliving fibers, textiles, and cordage such as thread, yarn, cloth, rope, wool, linen, hemp, silk, felt, canvas, and similar materials. Governs sensing, moving, tightening, loosening, knotting, braiding, weaving, unraveling, reinforcing, weakening, and reshaping existing fibers. It does not create material from nothing, control living plants or bodies, or replace Handcrafting and other mundane textile or fabrication work.

entries.name: Fire Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Generates and controls fire, heat, combustion, flame shape, burning intensity, and temperature amplification. Governs ignition, sustained burning, battlefield shock, forging heat, and fire hazards.

entries.name: Force Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates raw push, impact, pressure, resistance, kinetic release, invisible blows, and the direct transfer of applied force through bodies or objects. Force Arcana creates or directs force itself. Distinct from Power Arcana, which amplifies an action already being performed, and Motion Arcana, which changes the movement, speed, momentum, or trajectory of an existing body or object.

entries.name: Glass Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates glass, brittle transparency, cutting edges, lenses, reflection, refraction, fragile barriers, and glass-like magical structures. Distinct from Crystal Arcana because glass is worked, fragile, transparent, and unstable rather than mineral-rooted.

entries.name: Gravity Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates weight, falling, pressure, pull, crushing force, balance, and the rule that tells bodies where down should be. Gravity Arcana is conspicuous, disorienting, and difficult to conceal.

entries.name: Healing Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Restores physical harm through magical wound closure, illness treatment, toxin removal, stabilization, pain reduction, and accelerated natural recovery. Use Healing Arcana for magical healing; use Medicine for mundane diagnosis, surgery, bandaging, poultices, treatment, and recovery care.

entries.name: Heroic Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Channels heroic or sanctified force into courage, battle resolve, resistance, rallying presence, protective blessing, and exceptional effort under pressure. It strengthens the ability to stand, endure, act, and inspire in moments of danger. It does not create general-purpose magical barriers like Protection Arcana or provide unrestricted amplification of any action like Power Arcana.

entries.name: Hunger Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Rarity: Rare
Magic of hunger, craving, consumption, need, depletion, predatory focus, draining pressure, and power created by lack. Distinct from Blood Arcana because it governs appetite, emptiness, and depletion rather than blood, lineage, or injury.

entries.name: Illusion Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Creates false sensory impressions: images, phantom sounds, false smells, altered appearances, concealed details, and complete multi-sense fabrications. Strong illusions require consistency and context.

entries.name: Light Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Manipulates ordinary and magical light, including illumination, glare, color, reflection, refraction, visibility, focused radiance, and the suppression or concentration of light. Its effects work through light itself rather than raw kinetic force. Distinct from Heroic Arcana, which carries courage, sanctity, blessing, and heroic resolve.

entries.name: Lightning Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Generates and directs electrical energy, lightning strikes, charged fields, conductive magic, nerve shock, sudden impact, and volatile speed. It is powerful, bright, loud, and difficult to hide.

entries.name: Magnetism Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates magnetic attraction, repulsion, polarity, lodestone behavior, magnetic fields, alignment, and the pull exerted on magnetically responsive material. It can move or influence suitable metal through magnetism, but does not shape, reinforce, weaken, heat, or otherwise control metal as Metal Arcana does, and it does not create arbitrary Force effects against nonmagnetic targets.

entries.name: Memory Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Rare
Reads, preserves, organizes, clarifies, and restores memory traces, recollection, forgotten impressions, mnemonic patterns, and preserved experiences. It works through stored or recalled experience rather than active thought or emotion.

entries.name: Metal Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Magically manipulates metal, alloy, ore, forged objects, metal resonance, and worked arms or armor. Governs sensing, shaping, reinforcing, weakening, heating, cooling, and resonating metal. Use Metal Arcana for magical metal manipulation; use Smithing for mundane forging, shaping, repairing, and metalwork.

entries.name: Mirror Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Rare
Works through mirrors, reflections, reflective surfaces, reversal, reflected observation, mirror-windows, reflective conduits, and doubled spaces anchored to a mirror or reflection. Its imitation, redirection, and spatial effects must remain meaningfully tied to reflection. Mirror Arcana does not grant unrestricted Illusion Arcana, duplication, or Spatial Arcana simply because an effect resembles one of those domains.

entries.name: Moon Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of the moon and its phases: moonlight, nocturnal revelation, tides, hidden instinct, cyclical transformation, secrecy, dreamlike influence, and beast-nature expressed through lunar change. These effects are lunar manifestations rather than unrestricted mastery of Water, Light, Shadow, Dream, or Beast Arcana. Moon Arcana is strongest where phases, night, instinct, hidden truth, and transformation meaningfully matter.

entries.name: Motion Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Manipulates movement, momentum, acceleration, deceleration, balance, trajectories, and kinetic flow. Motion Arcana changes how an existing body or object moves and can redirect, hasten, slow, or arrest that movement. Distinct from Force Arcana, which creates or directs push, impact, and pressure, and Gravity Arcana, which governs pull, weight, falling, and the direction of down.

entries.name: Oath Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Rarity: Rare
Magic of sworn words, vows, witnessed promises, binding declarations, broken pledges, sacred contracts, and supernatural obligation. Oath Arcana strengthens, records, enforces, or imposes consequences on commitments that are actually made or formally accepted. It does not create consent, invent an oath where none was sworn, or turn an arbitrary command into a binding promise.

entries.name: Phoenix Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of phoenix-like destruction and renewal: rebirth, survival after ruin, cleansing flame, restoration through ash, life rekindled after defeat, and the refusal to let an ending remain final. Its fire and restoration serve the cycle of burning, surviving, cleansing, and returning; Phoenix Arcana does not grant unrestricted Fire Arcana, Healing Arcana, or Death Arcana. Even at legendary strength, death and rebirth remain consequential rather than casual.

entries.name: Plague Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates contagion, decay, fever, rot, spreading weakness, corrupted vitality, and magical blight. Distinct from Poison Arcana because it spreads disease-like corruption rather than isolated toxins.

entries.name: Poison Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Manipulates toxins, venoms, irritants, antidotal reactions, contamination, and bodily resistance to poison. Distinct from Plague Arcana, which spreads disease, decay, corruption, and magical blight.

entries.name: Power Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Magically amplifies effort, impact, endurance, and exertion through raw arcane output. Power Arcana strengthens an action already being performed: a strike hits harder, a leap carries farther, a shield holds longer, or a spell lands with greater force. It does not create free-standing pushes, invisible blows, or external force control like Force Arcana, and it does not replace Might, weapon skill, technique, or ordinary physical strength.

entries.name: Protection Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Creates magical defenses, personal shields, wards, barriers, damage reduction, protective auras, and resistance against hostile effects. Use Protection Arcana for magical barriers and wards; use Shields for physical shield blocking, bashing, cover, and positioning.

entries.name: Ruin Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of collapse, endings, fracture, failing structures, unraveling spells, doomed patterns, and the point where something can no longer remain whole. Ruin Arcana exposes, accelerates, or completes instability and failure, and is strongest where weakness, strain, damage, contradiction, or an existing ending can be exploited. It does not simply erase intact matter, automatically dispel any magic, or declare an otherwise sound target doomed without a plausible point of failure.

entries.name: Rune Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Inscribes magic into physical marks, symbols, materials, or prepared surfaces. Runes can hold effects, store energy, react to conditions, stabilize spells, or persist without constant concentration. Rune Arcana is defined by the magical inscription itself; Enchantment Arcana governs broader persistent imbuement, while Seal Arcana governs containment, suppression, and magical closure. Mundane writing uses Writing or Fine Script.

entries.name: Seal Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Rare
Magic of seals, closures, locks, bindings, containment, suppression, ward marks, held power, and guarded thresholds. Use Seal Arcana for magical containment, suppression, closure, ward-locks, and sealed power. Use Lock Picking for mundane locks, Traps for traps, and Rune Arcana for broader magical inscription.

entries.name: Shadow Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Magically manipulates shadow, darkness, light suppression, concealment, oppressive dark, hidden movement, and shadow-shaped force. Use Shadow Arcana when the character magically manipulates darkness or shadow; use Stealth for mundane sneaking, hiding, and quiet movement.

entries.name: Smoke Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Magically manipulates smoke, soot, ash-laden haze, suspended particulate clouds, scent carried through smoke, and drifting obscuration. Governs shaping cover, choking or redirecting smoke, masking scent, and reading movement through smoke-filled space. It does not grant general control over clean air and wind, liquid water or steam, or toxins merely because they are airborne.

entries.name: Soul Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Interacts with the living soul: inner essence, spiritual identity, the bond between self and body, soul injury, soul presence, and threats to personhood beneath the flesh. It can perceive, protect, affect, or stabilize the soul directly. Distinct from Spirit Arcana, which governs independent spirits and hauntings; Death Arcana, which governs death-state energy and the dead; and Healing Arcana, which restores ordinary physical harm.

entries.name: Sound Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates vibration, voice, rhythm, resonance, silence, shockwaves, echoes, and sonic pressure. It can communicate, disrupt, reveal, conceal, or break structures that cannot endure the right frequency.

entries.name: Sovereign Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of authority, legitimacy, rulership, command, banners, inheritance, recognition, and the supernatural weight of acknowledged sovereignty. It can reinforce recognized authority, make rightful command carry magical weight, and act through courts, armies, titles, succession, and public witness. Sovereign Arcana does not create legitimacy from nothing, compel arbitrary obedience without a relevant basis of authority, or replace ordinary Persuasion, Leadership, or Oath Arcana when those are the actual means at work.

entries.name: Spatial Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates distance, thresholds, pockets, crossings, folded rooms, hidden paths, and the rules separating one place from another. It is powerful because it makes walls, borders, and distance negotiable.

entries.name: Spirit Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Interacts with spirits, ghosts, animistic presences, hauntings, ancestor echoes, shrine entities, and unseen local powers. Distinct from Soul Arcana, which touches the living essence and identity of a person directly.

entries.name: Star Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of stars and the distant heavens: starlight, constellations, celestial navigation, cosmic omens, immense distance, cold radiance, fallen sky-matter, and patterns traced across the night sky. Star Arcana reads and expresses celestial relationships and distant stellar influence rather than granting unrestricted Light, Spatial, Divination, or Fate Arcana. Its strongest effects remain recognizably tied to stars, constellations, celestial distance, or material fallen from the heavens.

entries.name: Storm Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Rare
Manipulates storms as weather-scale convergence: thunderheads, atmospheric pressure, violent wind, rain, thunder, and lightning acting together as a storm system. Storm Arcana is broader and wilder than ordinary Air or Lightning Arcana when those forces are part of storm weather, but it does not grant unrestricted independent mastery of every air, lightning, or water effect outside that storm context.

entries.name: Sun Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of the sun: solar flame, daylight, sacred heat, purification, revelation, radiant judgment, battle resolve, and exposing radiance. Sun Arcana expresses these powers specifically through solar authority and presence. It does not grant unrestricted Fire Arcana, Light Arcana, or Heroic Arcana simply because solar manifestations can burn, illuminate, cleanse, or inspire.

entries.name: Titan Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of titan-like physical scale: colossal strength, mountain endurance, immense bodily weight, giant force, earth-shaking impact, bracing, carrying, resistance, and overwhelming physical presence. Titan Arcana magnifies the user's physical capacity and durability rather than granting independent Gravity Arcana or Earth Arcana, and it does not replace weapon technique or other trained combat skills.

entries.name: Twilight Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of dusk and the meeting of radiance and shadow: mingled light and darkness, transition, contrast, thresholds between illumination and obscurity, and power created where those opposites coexist. Twilight Arcana can veil through dimness, reveal through contrast, answer extreme radiance or darkness, and stress boundaries specifically expressed through their meeting point. It does not grant unrestricted Light Arcana, Shadow Arcana, Force Arcana, or generic authority over every kind of boundary.

entries.name: Water Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Manipulates water, liquid flow, pressure, currents, jets, floods, underwater breathing, cleansing, redirection, and aqueous environments. It is strongest where existing liquid is present.

entries.name: Wood Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Manipulates living plants, roots, vines, wood, timber, botanical growth, and organic plant shaping. Governs plant direction, living barriers, natural bindings, and shaping wood as a tool, obstacle, or weapon. Nonliving processed fibers, textiles, rope, thread, and cloth belong to Fiber Arcana, while ordinary woodworking and fabrication remain Handcrafting.

entries.name: Wyrd Arcana
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Rarity: Legendary
Magic of prophecy, fate-knots, curses, inherited doom, story-patterns, strange coincidence, old promises returning, and long-form patterns that bind events together. Wyrd Arcana recognizes, entangles, loosens, or twists those developing patterns rather than simply choosing an outcome. It does not grant unrestricted Divination, immediate probability control like Fate Arcana, or oath enforcement simply because promises and consequences can become part of a wyrd pattern.

entries.name: Acrobatics
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Balance, agility, tumbling, and precise body control. Governs complex movement under pressure.

entries.name: Animal Handling
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Calming, directing, training, bonding with, or controlling animals socially and behaviorally. Governs mount temperament, creature calming, working animals, and beast companions. Use Riding for mounted control, Natural Lore for animal knowledge, Tracking for physical trails, and Beast Arcana for magical animal interaction.

entries.name: Appraisal
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Appraising the value, quality, authenticity, craftsmanship, and market worth of objects, materials, trade goods, art, gems, equipment, and valuables. Do not use this skill for evaluating tactical situations, people, rooms, danger, magic, or social intent.

entries.name: Arcane Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Theoretical knowledge of magic: how it works, historical practitioners, identifying effects, and understanding arcane systems.

entries.name: Archival Research
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Systematic gathering and synthesis of information from archives, libraries, written records, maps, letters, legal documents, journals, registries, and other formal sources. Governs locating relevant material, cross-referencing sources, and drawing supported conclusions from records. Use Social Inquiry for live witnesses, interviews, and rumors, and Searching or Seeing for immediate physical investigation.

entries.name: Bargaining
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Negotiating prices, terms, and exchanges. Covers buying, selling, brokering, and trade negotiation.

entries.name: Brewing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Creating potions, alchemical compounds, food and drink, and biological preparations. Governs both recipe and process.

entries.name: Cart Driving
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Controlling wheeled vehicles: carts, carriages, wagons, coaches, and heavy road vehicles. Governs reins, direction, speed management, braking, load handling, and keeping control under stress. Do not use this skill for ships, boats, airships, or sail work.

entries.name: Cartography
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Creating and reading maps. Governs terrain interpretation, scale estimation, and representing geography accurately.

entries.name: Climbing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Ascending and descending vertical surfaces. Governs technique, grip endurance, and movement on difficult terrain.

entries.name: Courage
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Facing fear, resisting terror effects, and maintaining action under supernatural, overwhelming, or deadly threat. Use this for personal bravery and refusal to break, not for commanding others.

entries.name: Courtship
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Romantic social skill: expressing interest, flirting, reading reciprocation, and creating opportunities for willing courtship through warmth, confidence, attention, and personal appeal. Courtship can strengthen a romantic interaction when interest is possible, but it never creates attraction, overrides boundaries, or establishes a relationship by itself.

entries.name: Cryptography
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Encoding and decoding ciphers. Governs creating secure messages and breaking unknown encryption.

entries.name: Cultural Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of customs, traditions, political structures, and social norms of specific cultures and factions.

entries.name: Deception
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Telling convincing lies, misleading people, and maintaining false narratives under pressure.

entries.name: Disguise
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Altering appearance and manner to pass as someone else. Governs construction, maintenance, and social performance of disguise.

entries.name: Dragon Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge specific to dragons: Draconic Types and Natures, Origins, States, Conditions, known dragons, behavior, territories, signs, traditions, and recorded draconic history. Governs identifying and interpreting established draconic information, but does not grant Dragon Arcana or reveal facts that have not been learned, observed, or preserved in lore. Rare and valuable.

entries.name: Empathy
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Reading emotional states, hidden feelings, discomfort, fear, sincerity, stress, and unspoken intent from behavior, tone, posture, and small reactions. Do not use it to convince, command, deceive, intimidate, seduce, bargain, or perform socially; use the relevant Communication skill instead.

entries.name: Engineering
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Understanding of structures, mechanisms, and constructed systems. Governs siege equipment, architecture, and mechanical devices.

entries.name: Etiquette
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Correct behavior in formal and social contexts: court protocol, table manners, address forms, and ceremonial movement.

entries.name: Faction Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Specific knowledge of Eldaven's political factions, their structures, internal tensions, key figures, and ongoing agendas.

entries.name: Faith
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Drawing on sincere belief, doctrine, and spiritual conviction to resist corruption, maintain resolve under religious or moral pressure, endure challenges to belief, and stand by deeply held principles. Faith can support acts grounded in conviction or recognized religious practice, but does not by itself create supernatural miracles or substitute for Arcana.

entries.name: Fine Script
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Mundane fine-motor writing, formal scripts, detailed maps, decorative lettering, copied manuscripts, and precise non-magical inscription. Do not use this skill for magical runes, spell marks, wards, seals, or enchanted inscriptions; use Rune Arcana or a rune ability instead.

entries.name: Forbidden Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of banned, restricted, or dangerous magical and historical subjects. Governs the suppressed history of Eldaven and forbidden arcane theories.

entries.name: Gambling
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Games of chance and skill: reading opponents, bluffing, calculating odds, and knowing when to fold.

entries.name: Handcrafting
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Making, repairing, or modifying physical objects with hands and tools: woodworking, leatherwork, tailoring, jewelry, and general small-scale fabrication. Governs practical workmanship, fit, finish, assembly, and repair. Use Smithing for forging and dedicated metalworking, and Engineering for the design or analysis of complex structures and mechanisms.

entries.name: Hearing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Using hearing to gather information: detecting sounds, voices, movement, and using audio cues in darkness or at distance.

entries.name: Heraldry
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of noble houses, their symbols, lineage, territorial claims, and political standing. Governs identification and protocol.

entries.name: Historical Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of past events, figures, and civilizations. Governs identifying historical significance and applying historical patterns.

entries.name: Intimidation
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Using physical presence, implied threat, or demonstrated capability to force compliance or retreat.

entries.name: Jumping
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Distance and height leaps. Governs both running jumps and standing leaps under pressure or with load.

entries.name: Leadership
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Directing people in organized action: issuing commands, coordinating allies, giving battlefield orders, assigning roles, and asserting command authority. Use this for active leadership and group direction, not for private courage, resisting fear, or personal mental discipline.

entries.name: Legerdemain
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Sleight of hand, pickpocketing, palming objects, and close-range manual deception.

entries.name: Lock Picking
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Opening mechanical locks without the correct key. Governs pick technique and identifying lock types.

entries.name: Medicine
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Non-magical treatment of injury and illness through first aid, diagnosis, surgery, and recovery management.

entries.name: Might
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Raw physical force: lifting, breaking, holding, and applying strength against resistance.

entries.name: Military Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of warfare, tactics, unit types, fortifications, supply lines, formations, command structures, military history, and battlefield doctrine. Do not use it for executing attacks, defending in melee, issuing commands, rallying allies, or physically holding a line; use Fighting skills, Shields, Leadership, Courage, or Self-Discipline as appropriate.

entries.name: Musical Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of musical traditions, composition, and performance theory. Governs both creating and analyzing music.

entries.name: Natural Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of animals, plants, fungi, weather, terrain, natural hazards, and ecological systems. Governs identification, behavior prediction, foraging knowledge, and understanding natural survival conditions. Do not use it for physically following tracks, spotting hidden movement, searching an area, or noticing danger in the moment; use Tracking, Seeing, Searching, Hearing, or Smelling instead.

entries.name: Navigation
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Determining position and plotting routes by stars, landmarks, and instruments. Governs both land and sea navigation.

entries.name: Performance
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Formal and informal performance: acting, singing, playing instruments, oratory, and storytelling for an audience.

entries.name: Persuasion
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Making compelling arguments: appealing to emotion, reason, or self-interest to change what someone does or believes.

entries.name: Planar Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of planes, realms, dimensional boundaries, and entities that exist outside the material world.

entries.name: Relic Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of ancient artifacts, magical items of historical significance, and the traditions surrounding their creation and use.

entries.name: Religious Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of faiths, doctrines, rituals, sacred sites, and religious history. Governs theological debate and identifying religious significance.

entries.name: Riding
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Controlling a mount in ordinary and difficult conditions. Governs staying mounted, directing the animal, and mounted maneuvers.

entries.name: Rowing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Sustained oar-work in boats and vessels. Governs both technique and endurance over long pulls.

entries.name: Running
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Sustained movement at pace: sprinting, long-distance running, and chases. Governs endurance over distance.

entries.name: Sail Handling
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Managing sails, rigging, knots, lines, and shipboard crew coordination on sailing vessels. Governs practical sail work, trimming, reefing, and keeping sails functional under weather or combat pressure. Use Vessel Piloting for steering and directing the vessel itself.

entries.name: Searching
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Systematic examination of areas, objects, and people for hidden things: concealed items, secret doors, and subtle clues.

entries.name: Seeing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Visual observation: spotting details at range, reading environments, and noticing things others miss.

entries.name: Self-Discipline
entries.summary:
Attribute: Willpower
Controlling impulse, resisting manipulation, maintaining focus under distraction or temptation, and continuing disciplined action despite pressure. Use this for inner restraint and focus, not for social command.

entries.name: Smelling
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Using scent to gather information: detecting people, substances, environmental conditions, and recent events by smell.

entries.name: Smithing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Strength
Metalworking: forging, shaping, and repairing metal objects. Governs both quality and efficiency of metal craft.

entries.name: Social Inquiry
entries.summary:
Attribute: Communication
Active social investigation: asking the right questions, interviewing witnesses, following rumors, testing stories, identifying contradictions in testimony, and tracing social connections. It can infer motives through what people say and how their accounts fit together; use Empathy for directly reading emotions, stress, sincerity, or unspoken intent from behavior. Do not use Social Inquiry for physically searching rooms, objects, bodies, containers, ruins, camps, or hidden items.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Moving without being noticed. Governs silent movement, cover use, and avoiding detection.

entries.name: Swimming
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Movement through water. Governs distance, rough water, and staying afloat under load.

entries.name: Tasting
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Identifying substances by taste: detecting poison, assessing quality, and identifying components in food or drink.

entries.name: Thieves' Lore
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Knowledge of criminal customs, thieves' signs, fences, smugglers, gangs, black markets, informal territories, street codes, protection rackets, and how unlawful networks operate. Use this for understanding criminal systems, not for sneaking, lock picking, stealing by hand, or social persuasion.

entries.name: Tolerance
entries.summary:
Attribute: Constitution
Resistance to poisons, diseases, extreme temperatures, and other physical intrusions. Governs how long you can endure harm without failing.

entries.name: Touching
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Using touch to gather physical information: surface temperature, texture, vibration, density, pressure, seams, irregularities, and hidden mechanical features. Touching can notice physical signs left by an unusual effect, but does not by itself sense or identify invisible magical residue; use magical detection or relevant lore when the information is specifically arcane.

entries.name: Tracking
entries.summary:
Attribute: Perception
Following trails of physical evidence left by passage: footprints, broken vegetation, disturbed surfaces, and residual heat.

entries.name: Traps
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Setting, identifying, and disabling traps. Governs both the construction of effective traps and the safe removal of them.

entries.name: Vessel Piloting
entries.summary:
Attribute: Dexterity
Directing watercraft, airships, or other vessels by helm, rudder, controls, trim, or command of heading. Governs navigation control and response to changing conditions. Use Sail Handling for managing sails and rigging.

entries.name: Writing
entries.summary:
Attribute: Intelligence
Producing formal documents, legal records, correspondence, and literature. Governs both composition and the forms required.
